taskVersion.name: pilot-ves-label-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station Choba-LawnTennisField, Lawn Tennis Field, University of Port Harcourt, Choba Town. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 91.2 | 2.535 | 2.535
2 | 380.2 | 15.83 | 18.37
3 | 43.25 | 20.36 | 38.73
4 | 474.3 | 33.05 | 71.78
5 | 597.1 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve-type notation, we analyze the resistivity values of the five layers in depth order:
1.  Layer 1: 91.2 ohm-m
2.  Layer 2: 380.2 ohm-m
3.  Layer 3: 43.25 ohm-m
4.  Layer 4: 474.3 ohm-m
5.  Layer 5: 597.1 ohm-m

We evaluate the relationship for each group of three consecutive layers:
*   **Layers 1-2-3:** 91.2 < 380.2 > 43.25 (r1 < r2 > r3). This corresponds to the letter **K**.
*   **Layers 2-3-4:** 380.2 > 43.25 < 474.3 (r1 > r2 < r3). This corresponds to the letter **H**.
*   **Layers 3-4-5:** 43.25 < 474.3 < 597.1 (r1 < r2 < r3). This corresponds to the letter **A**.

Combining these letters in order, the curve type is KHA.

{"curve_type": "KHA"}
